assumptions: notes.txt is the only file and the single existing line is meant to be extended, not replaced

decisions.choice: Appended ' (reviewed)' to the existing line in notes.txt instead of rewriting or adding a new line.
decisions.whyItMatters: It keeps notes.txt a faithful one-line note while recording that the content was checked, so readers of the file get accurate state without altering the original text.

alternatives.option: Replace the line entirely with new wording
alternatives.consequence: Would discard the original note content and make the file no longer reflect what was previously recorded.
Would break the file's stated single-line shape and change the file's structure for a purely editorial tweak.

recommendation.reason: It is the smallest safe change that preserves the original content while marking the verification.
